    24 Jun 2026, 12:01 pm

    More than 18,000 natives have been planted across two key Waipā restoration sites, Lake Rotopiko and Sainsbury Road Reserve, as community-led restoration efforts gather pace across the district.

  • Storm to summit: Kakepuku Mountain reopens

    18 Jun 2026, 3:53 pm

    Hikers and walkers can return to Kakepuku Mountain, with the popular track reopening today following extensive repair and clean-up work.

    18 Jun 2026, 10:24 am

    Fixing Waipā's storm-battered roads is going to cost millions – and now councillors have decided how it will be paid for.

    17 Jun 2026, 4:52 pm
